title: Settlement batch fails reaching ledger-db
steps: Check ledger-db connection pool usage and active sessions
Confirm ledger-db primary is healthy (no failover in progress)
Re-run the settlement job after the database recovers

title: Generic database connectivity
steps: Check database server health and failover status
Check connection pool saturation in the application
Verify firewall / private endpoint routes from the app subnet

title: Pods OOMKilled
steps: Check container memory trend since the last deployment
Roll back the last release if memory grew after it
Temporarily raise the memory limit and open a leak investigation

title: Filesystem almost full
steps: Identify the largest directories on the volume
Purge or archive old extracts per retention policy
Expand the volume if growth is expected

title: TLS certificate expiry
steps: Confirm the certificate expiry date and the endpoints using it
Renew the certificate in Key Vault
Rotate the certificate on the gateway and verify the chain

title: Upstream integration returning 5xx
steps: Check the provider status page
Confirm the integration is retrying with back-off and not dropping records
Escalate to the vendor if the outage exceeds the SLA

title: Token signature validation failures
steps: Check identity provider signing-key rollover events
Refresh the JWKS cache on gateways and services
Verify service principal secrets have not expired
